description: a rollout failure that is not a timeout is reported at once, without waiting another slice

fake.stderr: Error from server (NotFound): deployments.apps "orders-api-app" not found

commands: kubectl --context test-cluster --namespace demo delete deployment,service,configmap --selector app.kubernetes.io/managed-by=plugbricks,plugbricks/brick,plugbricks/brick notin (orders-api,postgres) --ignore-not-found
kubectl --context test-cluster --namespace demo rollout status deployment/orders-api-app --timeout=15s
kubectl --context test-cluster --namespace demo get pods --selector plugbricks/service=orders-api-app --output json
